application-pilot career

Runs the job search around the applications: turns role criteria into a live shortlist, scores each role for fit with evidence, keeps a reviewable tracker with submission and follow-up dates, flags roles that have gone quiet, drafts the follow-up and the interview briefing, and reads the funnel weekly. applicant-kit writes the packet; application-pilot keeps the search alive. Skill Authoring

4 skills · draft · tune · package
draft-skill authoring

Creates a new agent skill from a plain idea: confirms the purpose before writing anything, checks the installed siblings for overlap, splits scripts from references from assets, writes a description that actually triggers, then validates it with check_skill.py. Written from scratch, so it carries no text from Qoder's built-in skill-creator, which ships without a licence permitting redistribution.

2 files · 112 lines · 8 workflow steps · 0 API keys

npx skills add arm-pz/draft-skill

Full install page → Source
tune-skill authoring

Audits and fine-tunes a skill that already exists: the description that never fires, overlap with installed siblings, stale names and counts, handoff contracts that do not hand off. Ships check_skill.py, a deterministic validator over frontmatter, folder and heading agreement, description length and reference paths that do not exist. Not for creating one from scratch; that is draft-skill.

4 files · 268 lines · 1 validator script · 0 API keys

Full install page → Source
prompts-to-skill authoring

Turns a list of your own prompts into a finished, tested skill, one skill per prompt: an intent interview, an overlap check against what is already installed, a draft written with draft-skill, trigger test cases that include near-misses, and a tune-skill gate at the end. It needs draft-skill and tune-skill and stops with a clear message if either is missing.

Ship Checks

3 skills · pre-launch audits
web-preflight release

Checks a site you own before you ship it, without pretending a status code is a finding. A 200 on /.env that matches the app shell is catch-all routing, a blanket 403 is an unanswered question, and a check that never ran becomes INCONCLUSIVE — never a pass.

4 verdicts · 19 fixed paths · 9 behavioral tests · ~215 lines · 0 API keys

pre-ship-performance-audit performance

Audits and fixes a web app's real-world speed before launch: four read-only subagents sweep twenty known slow-downs across images, bundles, database queries and servers, then the same mobile Lighthouse protocol, three runs per page, proves each fix before and after. Never removes a feature for a score, never invents a baseline, and asks before touching dependencies, the database or the deploy region.

4 subagents · 20 slow-downs · 6 phases · ~120 lines · 0 API keys

Full install page → Source
pre-ship-security-red-team release

Red-teams a web app you own before launch, in an isolated local environment. Three parallel read-only subagents run fourteen authorization and abuse checks across three groups (identity and authorization; UI and API bypass; browser, network, cache and AI), each with captured evidence, then the fix is rerun against the same check. A check that cannot fail is falsified first, and findings stay on the record even when the pass clears.

3 subagents · 14 checks · 9 files · local environments only
